narr: Scattered thunderstorms affected the southern Appalachian region on the evening of June 27th, and specifically far western Virginia where flash flooding occurred in Russell and Washington counties.
ev: Social media reports and county 911 dispatch reported that Indian Creek washed out Belfast Mills Rd at the intersection of US 19.

Flooding along Woodland Hills Road in Abingdon. Additional pictures received at 11:45 PM EDT via X show water running over neighborhood road, and water pooling in low spots to a depth of several inches, inundating the lower portions of mailbox posts. Standing water was also visible in front yards. A total of 2.5 inches of rain had fallen at the time of the second report.
Phone call report of Fall Hill Road being completely flooded, causing damage to the road.
